credentials.name: Shopify client credentials
credentials.help: Your Shopify app's client ID and secret (Dev Dashboard > your app > Settings), with read_products, write_products, read_metaobjects, write_metaobjects, read_metaobject_definitions and write_metaobject_definitions

credentials.name: YouTube Data API key
credentials.help: A YouTube Data API v3 key (Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials > Create credentials > API key; enable YouTube Data API v3 first)

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.help: Your Slack app's bot token (OAuth & Permissions), with chat:write

credentials.name: Slack signing secret
credentials.help: Your Slack app's Signing Secret (Basic Information)

credentials.name: DataForSEO
credentials.help: Optional: your DataForSEO API login and API password (dashboard > API Access), only if you turn on use_dataforseo

credentials.name: Supabase (Postgres)
credentials.help: Your Supabase database connection string (Connect > Session pooler), for workflow-supabase.json only
